program.ge_pattern: Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Pattern
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge and skills in compliance with state fire training requirements for Firefighter I and applicable certifications.
Operate emergency and non-emergency vehicles in compliance with state fire training requirements.
Demonstrate the necessary knowledge and skills as an Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) according to industry standards.
Utilize knowledge and skills to maintain health and fitness levels necessary for industry standards and/or job-specific duties.

notes: The 'Required Courses (Total 32.5 units)' figure is printed above the 'Complete all of the following' list, whose courses sum to 29 units; the 32.5 appears to cover both the required list and the 'Choose One' 3.5-unit block. Recorded as printed on the first block; reviewer should check.
The 'Choose One' block also states 'Complete the following number of units: 3.5'; both listed courses are 3.5 units, so one course satisfies it.
60 Total Units Required is printed in the award's unit requirements header and recorded as degree_total; no GE unit figure is printed.
Student may complete either the CC-GE or Cal-GETC pattern.
An outcomes lead-in appears near the description with no outcomes under it; the outcomes were taken from the Program Learning Outcomes section.
